termsLeft:
At Palm Living Interiors, our commitment to intentional design extends to every
detail, including our terms of service. These guidelines are crafted to ensure
transparency, trust, and a seamless experience.
QUOTATIONS & PRICING:
All quotations are valid for 7 calendar days from the date of issue.
Prices are subject to change after this period unless otherwise agreed in writing.
Additional work requested outside the scope of the original estimate will be
quoted separately. This includes any changes to existing scope.
PAYMENT TERMS:
Full prepayment required at the time of order confirmation.
Payment must be made via credit card or bank transfer to the account details
provided.
DELIVERY & INSTALLATION:
Clients will be notified of the delivery date at least 1 week in advance.
Any changes to the delivery schedule must be communicated at least 24 hours
prior.
Palm Living Interiors is not responsible for delays caused by external factors,
including supplier issues or client-requested changes.
STORAGE POLICY:
Items must be accepted within 3 days of notification that they are ready.
Storage beyond this period incurs a fee of AED250 per day.
Palm Living Interiors is not liable for damages resulting from extended storage.
If storage is required due to client-requested delays, written confirmation must be
provided and above fees would apply
RETURNS & INSPECTIONS:
Due to the bespoke nature of our pieces, all sales are final.
We encourage clients to inspect items upon delivery.
If any defect is identified, please share a photo with our team at
info@palmlivingae.com within 24 hours of receipt.
Palm Living Interiors will assess the issue and advise on next steps.
DESIGNS & REVISIONS:
Where applicable, designs are provided for custom-built furniture and joinery.
Where applicable, clients are responsible for reviewing, approving and signing
drawings prior to production.
Two design revisions are included.
Any additional revisions will incur a cost of AED1,000 each.
Palm Living Interiors is not liable for delays caused by late approvals or excessive
revisions.
Production will only start after all design approvals.
MANUFACTURING TOLERANCES:
Due to the nature of handcrafted production, a tolerance of 1–3 cm may apply to
final dimensions.
Natural materials such as wood, stone, and marble may exhibit variations in colour,
shades, texture, and veining. These are considered part of their organic character
and not defects.
Palm Living Interiors ensures all products meet quality standards and design
intent.
There is no warranty for any breakages after delivery, therefore aftercare of the
items is essential.
termsRight:
Palm Living Interiors shall not be held liable for any uneven, out of plumb, or
non-level walls, ceilings, or other structural surfaces that result from the original
developer’s construction of the property. Any such pre existing irregularities are
deemed outside the scope of Palm Living Interior’s responsibility, and Palm
Living Interiors shall not be required to perform corrective work unless
specifically included in the scope of work and agreed upon in writing by both
parties.
TV & MEDIA WALL DISCLAIMER:
Palm Living Interiors is not responsible for damage to existing walls, electrical
points, or concealed wiring during installation of TV units or media walls.
Clients must ensure all electrical and AV points are installed prior to delivery.
A call-out fee of AED500 applies for any post-installation adjustments or re-
visits.
We recommend consulting with a qualified technician for AV setup and
integration.
We have a disclaimer to be signed by the client to move, lift or install any
personal belongings, electricals and furniture.
INSTALLATION WARRANTY:
All installation work carried out by Palm Living is covered by a limited warranty
of six (6) months from the date of completion. This warranty does not apply to
external factors beyond our control.
ORDER CONFIRMATION & CANCELLATION
Once an order has been placed, signed, and confirmed, it is considered final
and binding. Palm Living does not offer refunds or cancellations on confirmed
orders, as each project is tailored and scheduled with care.
REMOVAL & DISPOSAL OF EXISTING FURNITURE:
Palm Living Interiors does not offer removal or disposal of existing furniture
unless agreed in writing.
If removal is requested, a separate quotation will be provided.
Clients are responsible for ensuring the space is clear prior to installation.
INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY:
All designs, drawings, specifications, and documentation remain the property
of Palm Living Interiors.
Unauthorised use, reproduction, or distribution of our materials is strictly
prohibited and may result in legal action.
Palm Living Interiors reserves the right to showcase completed projects for
marketing purposes unless otherwise agreed.
LIABILITY & FORCE MAJEURE:
Palm Living Interiors is not liable for delays or damages caused by events
beyond our control, including but not limited to supplier disruptions, natural
disasters, or government restrictions.
We will make every effort to communicate and resolve any such issues
promptly.
CONTACT:
For support, questions, or further clarification, please reach out to
info@palmlivingae.com
We’re here to support your journey toward curated living. Thank you for
choosing Palm Living Interiors.
